text: でんき　ポケモン　つかわせたら　アメリカ　ナンバー１　らしいぜ！

structure.jp: でんき　ポケモン　つかわせたら
structure.en: if you have him use Electric Pokémon

structure.jp: アメリカ　ナンバー１　らしいぜ！
structure.en: he's number one in America, they say!

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: つかう 'use' becomes つかわせる 'let someone use'. With たら, 'if you let him use' is a set way to say 'when it comes to using'. つかわせたら = 'when it comes to using them'.

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい at the end says this is what the speaker has heard, not something he knows first-hand. ナンバー１ らしい = 'he's number one, they say'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that thing happens. つかわせたら = 'if you let him use them'.
